NASA Earth Observatory turn5view1 L260-L261 identifies the Ross Sea and describes the Ross Ice Shelf occupying the adjacent area; this links the shelf to the sea. AADC turn7view0 L17,L30-L33 classifies Bellingshausen as a sea and locates it west of Alexander Island; AADC Amundsen turn3view0 L17,L27 locates Amundsen off Marie Byrd Land; AWI turn7view0 L2283 identifies Weddell separately. The three distractors are actual Antarctic seas and the answer is unique.
